(Korean: '''포켓몬 영어 마스터''' ''Pokémon English Master'') is a [[Pokémon manga|Pokémon manhwa]] published in South Korea by [[The Pokémon Company#Pokémon Korea, Inc.|Pokémon Korea, Inc.]] in 2015. It was written and illustrated by 배연오 and supervised by 박약우 (Volume 1) and 김태은 (Volume 2). It was developed to help children to learn English.
